work.title: Occupy Democracy
work.description: Paste-up mural on a black ground depicts an ochre-yellow silhouetted profile of a crowned figure occupying the upper register, overlaid with repeated 'occupydemocracy' text strips and red lettering reading 'BEN NAZ.' Below, a grey-blue owl rendered in hatched brushwork adjoins a white Georgian door numbered 178A bearing small red snowman tags.
